definitions.explanation: A work that takes a character or setting from an existing film, series, novel or game and builds a new story around it. In business it also names a company or division split off from its parent.

examples.japanese: スピンオフ⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{作|つく}られた→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
⟦{脇役|わきやく}→脇役：13933_wakiyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{主人公|しゅじんこう}→主人公：11404_shujinkou⟧にしたスピンオフ。
examples.english: A spin-off with a supporting character as the lead.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧スピンオフ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{配信|はいしん}される→配信する：23206_haishinsuru⟧。
examples.english: A spin-off of the popular drama starts streaming next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{研究部門|けんきゅうぶもん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧スピンオフ⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{新会社|しんがいしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設立|せつりつ}した→設立する：17473_setsuritsusuru⟧。
examples.english: The company spun off its research division as a new company.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- スピンオフ⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧: a spin-off work
- スピンオフドラマ・スピンオフ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧: a spin-off series, a spin-off film
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧スピンオフ: a spin-off of ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{外伝|がいでん}→外伝：12147_gaiden⟧: a side story, usually set in the same world and often told by the original author; スピンオフ is the general term, common for TV and film.
- ⟦{続編|ぞくへん}→続編：13818_zokuhen⟧: a sequel, which continues the main story rather than branching off it.
